title: Conquest of Koneswaram Temple
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Conquest of Koneswaram Temple", at revision 1373846628, opens: "The Destruction of the Hindu temple of Koneswaram, at Trincomalee by the Portuguese governor of Ceylon, Constantino de Sá de Noronha took place in April 1622. At the time of the desecration, Koneswaram served as a Danish fortress." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q125166578, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "Portuguese destruction of a Danish-held Hindu temple". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
